name: synthetic_quadruped_triangle_loc_v1
description: Second, SEPARATE ground-truth trajectory for the T3 localization test, in the SAME synthetic scene as test_trajectory.json but on a different closed route (a triangle) with a different start point. T3 runs the real localizer_node against the frozen scene-frame prior map over THIS trajectory, so the localization estimate is never the mapping run's odometry and the map was never built from this trajectory.

fastlio2_init_expectation.note: Same B3 edge case as the mapping trajectory: the trot-in-place prologue is not judged static, so the max-wait fallback fires.

notes: The scene (room box + pillars) is byte-identical to test_trajectory.json so the frozen prior map generated from that scene applies unchanged.

Route: closed triangle (7,3) -> (11,3) -> (7,11) -> (3,3) -> (7,3); perimeter ~25.9 m; duration 60 s covers the 6 s hold plus a complete lap. It starts mid-edge so the initial heading is the straight edge direction (yaw 0).
The initial pose for the relocalize service is the trajectory definition's start pose (a declared placement of the robot in the scene), not a GT measurement of this run.
